favourite.heading: Why Washington can pull away
bullets: Washington is the better football team by 38.1 points on opponent-adjusted results — but about 86% of that rating is still last season carried forward, and in a portal era last season is a different team (+38.1 pts).
Playing at Washington is worth 4.1 points — the league-wide home-field number, because a per-venue table was tested and could not be told apart from the home team’s own quality (+4.1 pts).

underdog.heading: Why Eastern Washington can keep it close
bullets: The outcome range is 15.5 points wide at one sigma — p10 +18.2 to p90 +63.2 for Washington, so a projection of +42.2 still produces results a long way either side of it.
It is early enough that both ratings still lean on preseason belief — it widens the outcome range by about 6%.
70% of the model’s own input contract was empty for this game — no starter, injury, schedule or per-player talent context reached it, so the number leans on team strength more than it should.
Eastern Washington is not in the FBS rating set, so EdgeDesk cannot measure what it does well. An unmeasured opponent is an unknown, not a weak one, and the size of the gap is not established.
